about.bio: Hi, my name is Erik Allmuca I began my journey in cybersecurity over 3.5 years ago and have since dedicated myself to protecting digital systems, analyzing vulnerabilities, and strengthening network defenses. With a strong focus on ethical hacking, system hardening, and proactive threat mitigation, I go beyond conventional security practices — delivering tailored, high-impact solutions. Cybersecurity isn't just my field — it's my passion and mission.
